title: The Cap Seller and the Monkeys
summary: A cap seller falls asleep in the forest, and when he wakes up, his caps are gone. A story about how clever thinking helps solve problems.
pages: Once upon a time, long ago, a cap seller was walking to town to sell his caps. The road went through a forest. After walking for a long time, he got a little tired.
He decided to rest for a while, and fell asleep under a tree in the forest. But there were some monkeys in that tree. The monkeys climbed down from the tree and took the cap seller's caps.
When the cap seller woke up, he was shocked to see that his sack was empty. He looked for the caps here and there.
The monkeys had put the caps on their heads. The cap seller saw the monkeys wearing his caps.
He thought and thought, and then he had an idea for how to get his caps back.
He took off his own cap and threw it toward the monkeys.
The monkeys copied the cap seller and threw their caps toward him too. And that's how the cap seller got all his caps back.
The cap seller gathered up all his caps and put them in his sack.
The cap seller waved goodbye to the monkeys and walked away smiling, with his caps.
